title: Paul McCartney live: Air Canada Centre, Toronto | 2005
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Air Canada Centre in Toronto, Canada, on 10 October 2005.

It was the 13th show of the US Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between September and November 2005. This show was seen by 16,924 fans, and was the only Canadian date of the tour.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the Air Canada Centre on 13 April 2002 for the Driving World Tour. He returned there on 8 and 9 August 2010 for the Up And Coming Tour; and 17 October 2015 for Out There Tour.
